# Dumply (덤플리)

> Dumply is a brain-dump tool. Pour out whatever is floating around in your head without organizing it, and an AI (Alfredo, a detective penguin character) automatically sorts it into tasks, schedules, feelings, and things you're still mulling over. It's a free Chrome extension — no sign-up, installed in 30 seconds — designed for people with noisy minds, including those with ADHD tendencies. Available in Korean, English, and Japanese.

## Key features
- Brain dump: type thoughts as they come, in the browser side panel
- AI auto-sorting: each line is classified as a task, schedule, feeling, or open question
- MoSCoW prioritization: keep only what really matters today
- Google Calendar integration: scheduled items appear alongside your board
- BYOK (bring your own key): AI sorting runs on your own Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini API key — no subscription
- Privacy: data and API keys are stored locally in the browser; calendar data comes straight from the Google API

## Products
- [Dumply Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/anageghlhlgmcabcgchboedlbdgfiali): main product, free — details: [KO](https://www.dumply.app/extension) · [EN](https://www.dumply.app/en/extension) · [JA](https://www.dumply.app/ja/extension)
- [Prompt Library](https://prompts.dumply.app/): save and instantly retrieve your frequently used AI prompts (beta) — details: [KO](https://www.dumply.app/prompts) · [EN](https://www.dumply.app/en/prompts) · [JA](https://www.dumply.app/ja/prompts)
- Dumply Finance: a dump-first money tracker, in the works — details: [KO](https://www.dumply.app/finance) · [EN](https://www.dumply.app/en/finance) · [JA](https://www.dumply.app/ja/finance)
- Priority Planner, iOS/Android apps: coming soon

## 한국어 요약
Dumply는 브레인덤프 도구입니다. 머릿속 생각을 정리하지 않고 그대로 쏟아내면, AI 탐정 펭귄 '알프레도'가 할 일·일정·감정·고민으로 자동 분류합니다. Chrome 확장 무료, 회원가입 없이 설치 30초. ADHD 성향이 있거나 머릿속이 시끄러운 사람들을 위해 설계되었습니다.

## 日本語の概要
Dumplyはブレインダンプツールです。頭の中の考えを整理せずそのまま書き出すと、AI探偵ペンギン「アルフレド」がタスク・予定・気持ち・悩みに自動で仕分けます。無料のChrome拡張、登録不要でインストール30秒。頭の中がうるさい人のために設計されています。
